name: Peninnah (Elkanah's second wife)
title: Elkanah's Fertile Wife
summary: Peninnah was Elkanah's second wife and the mother of several of his children. She is known for having tormented and humiliated Hannah because of her barrenness, which drove Hannah to earnest prayer and led to Samuel's birth.

keyEvents.title: Wife of Elkanah
keyEvents.description: Peninnah was married to Elkanah from Ramah, a Levite from the hill country of Ephraim. She was his second wife alongside Hannah.

keyEvents.title: Mother of Many Children
keyEvents.description: Unlike Hannah, who was barren, Peninnah had borne several sons and daughters to Elkanah.

keyEvents.title: Humiliated Hannah
keyEvents.description: Peninnah tormented and offended Hannah repeatedly because of her barrenness, especially during the annual pilgrimages to Shiloh.

keyEvents.title: Rivalry at the Sacrifices
keyEvents.description: When Elkanah sacrificed, he gave portions to Peninnah and all her children, but Hannah received only one portion, which intensified the tension between the wives.
